quotations.old_english: Ðus mæg mihtig man, and freóndspédig, his dǽdbóte, mid freónda fultume, micelum gelíhtan
quotations.english: thus may a powerful man, and rich in friends, greatly lighten his penance, with the help of his friends

source_text: freónd-spédig; adj. Rich in friends; am&i-long;c&o-long;rum d&i-long;ves :-- Ðus mæg mihtig man, and freóndspédig, his dǽdbóte, mid freónda fultume, micelum gelíhtan thus may a powerful man, and rich in friends, greatly lighten his penance, with the help of his friends, L. P. M; Th. ii. 286, 13.
